summary: A one-line documentation fix in the repository-root AGENTS.md (imported by CLAUDE.md) that changes the documented auth-strategy config key from `config.strategy` to `config.authStrategy`. AGENTS.md is agent guidance for contributors to this monorepo; the root package is private and nothing found packages or ships this file. No runtime, contract or release behaviour changes. No material failure scenario was found; the change reduces drift between agent guidance and the API.

evidence.claim: The only change replaces `config.strategy` with `config.authStrategy` in the identity-aware encryption bullet.
`ClientConfig.authStrategy` is the current field; `strategy` is marked @deprecated as an alias that is still honoured.
Encryption() resolves `authStrategy ?? strategy` and warns when the deprecated `strategy` is present, so the old documented key still works and only adds a warning.
Existing tests cover `config.authStrategy` and the deprecated `config.strategy` alias. They were not run.
CLAUDE.md imports AGENTS.md as the single source of project instructions.
The root package is `private: true`, so the root AGENTS.md is not published as part of an npm package from the root.
AGENTS.md has 19 commits before base (14 recent, 4 authors). It is frequently edited guidance, not a sign of risk.
